source.title: AFI Catalog: Goodfellas (1990)
source.evidence: AFI credits Robert De Niro as James ["Jimmy the Gent"] Conway; Liotta as Henry Hill, Pesci as Tommy DeVito, and Bracco as Karen Hill.

items.uniqueness: All four listed performers belong to the cast but only De Niro is credited as Jimmy Conway.

source.title: AFI Catalog: Scarface (1983)
source.evidence: AFI credits Al Pacino as Tony Montana; Steven Bauer as Manny Ray and Michelle Pfeiffer as Elvira Hancock.

items.uniqueness: Pacino is the sole Tony Montana option; Bauer and Pfeiffer play distinct named roles, and De Niro was considered but is not the credited performer.
